in_hebrew.name: דון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Don is derived from the Hebrew root 'dun', which means 'to judge' or 'to rule'. This name can be associated with the biblical figure of King Saul, who was known as 'Dov' in Hebrew, meaning 'bear,' which is related to the root 'dun.' Saul was a ruler and judge over Israel.

in_greek.name: Δωνατιών
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Don in Greek may be derived from the Greek name 'Δωνατιών (Donatios),' which means 'given by God.' This name is not directly mentioned in the New Testament, but it is a common name in early Christian literature.

in_latin.name: Donatus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Donatus is derived from the Latin word 'donare,' meaning 'to give.' The name means 'given by God' and is a common name in early Christian history.
